list_skills: list skills installed in TRL, an agent directory, or a custom path
install_skill: install a TRL skill to an agent directory like claude or codex with global or project scope
uninstall_skill: uninstall a skill from an agent directory or custom path by skill name
resolve_target_path: resolve an agent name with scope or a custom path string to a concrete filesystem directory
list_agent_names: list the supported agent names like claude, codex, and opencode
